# Module pages

Each page describes one module of MMX: what it manages, its inputs and outputs, examples, how it works, its errors, where it is tested, and why it works this way. `mmx describe-module NAME` prints the same page in a terminal.

## Files and links

| Module | What it does | Tested on |
|---|---|---|
| [`file`](file.md) | one regular file from content, template, source, or files already on the node; metadata of an existing file; or removal | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Arch Linux, openSUSE Leap 16.1, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 45 |
| [`line`](line.md) | one line of an existing file, selected by a regular expression or its exact text; prefer a drop-in or whole file where the program has one | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Arch Linux, openSUSE Leap 16.1, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 45 |
| [`edit_file`](edit_file.md) | the text of an existing file, changed by a filter command the author writes; for edits line cannot make; prefer a drop-in, a whole file, or line | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Arch Linux, openSUSE Leap 16.1, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 45 |
| [`symlink`](symlink.md) | one symbolic link and its target text | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Arch Linux, openSUSE Leap 16.1, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 45 |
| [`read_file`](read_file.md) | reads one file on the node, so a later node task or, through a fleet stage output, another node can use its content | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Arch Linux, openSUSE Leap 16.1, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 45 |

| [`reboot`](reboot.md) | reboots the node as the last task of a fleet stage, not in a role, task block, or loop; the controller waits for the node to return on a new boot. MMX never reboots the machine that runs the controller process: a fleet stage that ends with reboot fails on that node before its first node task, in a dryrun and in a run | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Arch Linux, openSUSE Leap 16.1, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 45 |

## Scheduled jobs

| Module | What it does | Tested on |
|---|---|---|
| [`systemd_scheduled_job`](systemd_scheduled_job.md) | a command that systemd runs on a schedule: a oneshot service `<name>.service` and a timer `<name>.timer`, checked with systemd-analyze, with the timer enabled and started; output goes to the journal (journalctl -u `<name>`), and a run never starts while the previous one is still going | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |

| Module | What it does | Tested on |
|---|---|---|

| [`ssh_key_pair`](ssh_key_pair.md) | an SSH key pair for an account, without a passphrase, created once with the node's ssh-keygen (package openssh-client on Debian and Ubuntu, openssh on the Red Hat family) and never replaced | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |

| [`firewalld_zone`](firewalld_zone.md) | Create or remove a firewalld zone. When needed, the task reloads firewalld. A reload replaces every zone's running settings with its stored settings. ## Official extra modules

These modules are Starlark scripts that ship with MMX in `official_extra_modules/` beside `mmx`. Each one's page is the `README.md` in its directory.

| Module | What it does | Tested on |
|---|---|---|
| [`create_partitions_on_empty_disk`](../../../official_extra_modules/create_partitions_on_empty_disk/README.md) | Writes a GPT partition table with named partitions on a disk that holds nothing yet, with sfdisk; a disk that holds anything else fails the task, and nothing ever forces it. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`grow_filesystem_to_fill_device`](../../../official_extra_modules/grow_filesystem_to_fill_device/README.md) | Grows a mounted ext4 or XFS filesystem to fill its block device, without shrinking, checking, repairing, or creating a filesystem. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`grow_partition_into_free_space_after_it`](../../../official_extra_modules/grow_partition_into_free_space_after_it/README.md) | Grows one existing partition into the free space after it through growpart, without changing its contents. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`incus_instance`](../../../official_extra_modules/incus_instance/README.md) | Manages one Incus container or virtual machine on the node: its profiles, its configuration, its devices, and whether it runs. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`incus_profile`](../../../official_extra_modules/incus_profile/README.md) | Manages one Incus profile on the node: its description, its configuration, and its devices. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`libvirt_domain`](../../../official_extra_modules/libvirt_domain/README.md) | Manages one libvirt domain, which is a virtual machine, through virsh. It defines the domain from an XML file on the node, starts it or shuts it off, and sets whether libvirt starts it when the node boots. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`lvm_logical_volume`](../../../official_extra_modules/lvm_logical_volume/README.md) | Manages one LVM logical volume, which a later run can grow together with its filesystem and never shrinks, with the programs of the package lvm2. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`lvm_volume_group`](../../../official_extra_modules/lvm_volume_group/README.md) | Manages one LVM volume group and its physical volumes, with the programs of the package lvm2; it never wipes a device. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |
| [`mongodb_user`](../../../official_extra_modules/mongodb_user/README.md) | Manages one user of a MongoDB server, with its password and its roles, through MongoDB's shell mongosh on the server's node. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04, Rocky Linux 9, AlmaLinux 10 |

| [`pg_auto_failover_node`](../../../official_extra_modules/pg_auto_failover_node/README.md) | Manages one PostgreSQL node of a pg_auto_failover formation on its database server, with its systemd unit, its failover settings, maintenance, and its PostgreSQL settings. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 |
| [`pg_auto_failover_primary`](../../../official_extra_modules/pg_auto_failover_primary/README.md) | Makes one node of a pg_auto_failover formation its primary with a planned switchover, on the monitor's server. | Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 |
